entries.name: capdenied

entries.promise: On a capability denial capdenied carries {agentId,need,reason}; harness.js accumulates the error and world.js flashes the desk + hudNote 'run blocked'.

entries.name: channel.connect
entries.purpose: Adapter transport health: poll up / network down / fatal token error.

entries.name: channel.delivery

entries.name: channel.inbound

entries.name: cron.skipped

entries.promise: On a skip cron.skipped carries {jobId,reason:<enum>}; maintqueststore logs it (read-only subscription).

entries.name: cron.tick
entries.purpose: The scheduler pulse: how many due jobs it planned/fired/skipped/deferred this pass.
